title: The company, contact, Accounts, Contacts and Booking pages now fit on a phone
text: On a phone, these five pages were wider than the screen, so some buttons (like View as client) slid out of reach. Now the buttons on the company and contact pages wrap onto the next line, the filters on the Accounts and Contacts lists scroll sideways inside their own row instead of stretching the page, the Leads header on Booking wraps, and the Open workspace cards stack with the button underneath so the title is readable. On a computer nothing changes.
points: Open a company on your phone: View as client is on screen, ready to tap
Open the Accounts list: the Status filter scrolls inside its own row; the page no longer moves sideways
Open a contact: Email, Message, WhatsApp, Lifecycle Audit and Delete / Merge wrap instead of running off the edge
